name: Purge feedback observation in disposable fixtures

steps._note: CodexTest-prefixed disposable save only. This arms native audio observation and captures the existing bounded feedback trace. It does not discover/clear a POI by itself. Use actual on-foot boundary traversal and native combat between before/after observations; require exact POI identities, native death receipts, UI screenshots and one feedback pair per live transition. Load/re-enter controls must add no feedback. Actual sounds must have advancing native clip samples; dispatch counts alone are insufficient. Guard remains ON.
